name: High Executor Hadrec
summary: At the Sepulcher, High Executor Hadrec directs the Forsaken garrison across Silverpine Forest. He oversees defense against threats such as the Rot Hide gnolls and investigates scouts missing across the zone.

sections.title: Commander at the Sepulcher
sections.body: High Executor Hadrec directs Forsaken military operations from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. The Dark Lady’s forces hold Tirisfal Glades, but Silverpine faces hostile Dalaran mages, feral worgen, and encroaching gnolls. Hadrec must strengthen Forsaken control and suppress threats to Undercity authority south of the capital.

sections.title: The Rot Hide Scourge
sections.body: The Rot Hide gnolls and Fenris Isle occupy much of Hadrec’s attention. Tainted by undeath, the beasts have overrun the Dead Fields and the shores of Lake Lordamere, threatening Forsaken patrols. Hadrec sends agents to search ruined ferries and farmsteads for clues, learn what empowers the gnolls, and prepare a strike against their island stronghold.

sections.title: Eye on Shadowfang
sections.body: Hadrec watches reports from the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken’s secretive intelligence arm. When covert operatives vanish near Shadowfang Keep, Hadrec sends agents to learn their fate and keep the Dark Lady informed about the archmage Arugal and his cursed worgen.

faq.answer: Hadrec commands the Forsaken garrison at the Sepulcher and directs military operations across Silverpine Forest. His rank is High Executor.

faq.q: Where can High Executor Hadrec be found?
faq.answer: You can find Hadrec inside the Sepulcher, a Forsaken settlement in central Silverpine Forest along the main north-south road.

faq.q: What threats does Hadrec direct players against?
faq.answer: Hadrec directs soldiers and adventurers against Rot Hide gnolls in the Dead Fields and on Fenris Isle. He also oversees the search for missing Deathstalker spies and efforts to learn what is happening inside Shadowfang Keep.

faq.q: What does a High Executor do in Forsaken military structure?
faq.answer: A High Executor is a senior Forsaken field commander. The rank carries strategic oversight of a regional outpost or front under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: Why is Hadrec interested in Fenris Isle?
faq.answer: Hadrec is interested in Fenris Isle because it has become the Rot Hide gnolls’ main den. He coordinates reconnaissance and a planned assault to break their leadership and secure Lake Lordamere and nearby waterways for Forsaken supply lines.

faq.q: What is Hadrec's connection to Shadowfang Keep?
faq.answer: Hadrec works with the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken espionage order. When scouts sent toward Shadowfang Keep fail to report back, he sends trusted agents to investigate and learn what happened to them.

angles.text: As a Forsaken traveling south from Deathknell, you find Hadrec speaking for Undercity’s high command. He organizes newly risen undead to defend Lordaeron.
As a Horde ally arriving from Kalimdor, you can report to Hadrec and help steady Silverpine, where the Horde’s hold in northern Lordaeron remains tenuous.
As a rogue, you may work with the Deathstalkers under Hadrec’s command. You can recover missing comrades and gather enemy ichor and documents.
